unit.why: A memorate quoted from a book's preface: an eyewitness describes how a holy rabbi expounded Sha'ar ha-Gilgulim at midnight, his listeners wept, and he roused them to repentance.
unit.boundary_note: Borderline: the text is largely a description of the rabbi's habitual practice rather than a single event.

stories.start_quote: ובס׳ הנ״ל בהקדמה וז״ל ובעת שהיה
stories.summary_en: An eyewitness recounts that the rabbi, in good spirits at midnight, expounded the doctrine of reincarnations from the Lurianic writings before his companions, who wept; he urged them to repentance, and apparently intended thereby to repair the souls of the wandering wicked.

tags.why: The discourse centres on transmigrations of souls.
